answer: One defence is a small refundable stake that only matures after a history of useful work. A fresh identity is like a juniper seedling: it must grow slowly through verified contributions before it earns real weight. Cheap copies cannot fake that time, and a zephyr of new accounts cannot outweigh rooted reputations. Copper-strong proof comes from peers staking their own standing on a vouch, so a sybil that vouches for itself burns its own collateral.
